message.villager_workstations.station_pl: Ranch station placed, %s front/back, %s left/right, %s up, %s down
message.villager_workstations.worker_rec: Called the worker back to the station
message.villager_workstations.worker_no_: No room to summon a worker - clear a space beside the station
message.villager_workstations.highlight_: Work area highlight: only while holding a workstation
config.villager_workstations.enable_bree: Whether the rancher feeds animals to breed them. Independent of slaughtering, so either job can run on its own. Feed kept in a feed box inside the work area is drawn from first; feed left in the station is still used.
config.villager_workstations.breed_inter: How long the rancher waits after feeding one animal before feeding another. 20 ticks is one second.
config.villager_workstations.max_animals: Breeding of a species pauses once this many of them are inside the area, babies included.
config.villager_workstations.feed_babies: Also feed babies to speed up their growth. This eats through feed quickly.
config.villager_workstations.play_feed_s: Play the eating sound every time an animal is fed. The happy particles show up either way.
config.villager_workstations.enable_cull: Whether the rancher slaughters surplus animals. Independent of breeding, so either job can run on its own.
config.villager_workstations.keep_adults: Adults of a species the rancher keeps. Anything above this gets slaughtered. Babies are never slaughtered, and neither are tamed or named animals.
config.villager_workstations.cull_interv: How long the rancher waits after finishing one animal off before starting on the next.
config.villager_workstations.instant_kil:
On: one blow finishes an animal off whatever the rancher is holding.
Off: it hits for its weapon's damage and keeps swinging until the animal drops. Drops are the same either way.
config.villager_workstations.enable_shea: The rancher carries its own shears, so there is nothing to stock. Wool lands on the ground and the sweep that always follows a harvest picks it up. Named and tamed animals are left alone.
config.villager_workstations.enable_milk: Needs a milk barrel touching the station on any of its six sides. The milk goes into the barrel, which holds 64 buckets; bring an empty bucket to the barrel to draw one out. Cows are left alone while there is no barrel or the barrel is full, so nothing is milked away to nowhere.
config.villager_workstations.work_interv: How often the worker looks around for its next job while idle.
config.villager_workstations.worker_resp: How long the station waits before summoning a replacement for a worker that died or went missing.
config.villager_workstations.open_fence_: Let the worker open a fence gate that is in its way and shut it again once through, so nothing else gets out with it. Off: gates count as solid wall, same as for any other mob.
config.villager_workstations.shove_block: Let the worker shoulder mobs in front of it out of the way while walking, instead of pathing the long way round or giving up. They are only nudged sideways, never through a gateway, and players are left alone.
config.villager_workstations.highlight_a:
On: the work area highlight is always visible.
Off: it only shows while holding a workstation. The hotkey toggles this at any time.
config.villager_workstations.show_worker: Print what the worker is doing over its head: current job, distance to its target, and why it is standing still. Useful for working out where a station is stuck.
config.villager_workstations.worker_skin: What this station's worker looks like. Purely cosmetic, and set per station, so two stations side by side can be told apart at a glance.
config.villager_workstations.enable_till: Hoe registered plots that got trampled back to bare ground. The farmer carries its own hoe; you do not have to supply one.
config.villager_workstations.enable_sowi: Plant bare plots with the seeds this station has been given. Which seeds those are comes from the container, and how the field is divided between them from the Seeds tab.
config.villager_workstations.enable_harv: Break crops that have finished growing. The produce lands on the ground and the sweep that always follows harvesting picks it up.
config.villager_workstations.harvest_gou: Break melons and pumpkins that have grown, anywhere in the work area rather than only on registered plots. Only fruit still attached to a stem is taken, so anything you have built out of pumpkins is left alone, and the stem grows another one afterwards.
config.villager_workstations.harvest_mus: Break brown and red mushrooms anywhere in the work area. The farmer does not put any back, and mushrooms spread very slowly on their own, so a patch it clears out can take a long time to return.
config.villager_workstations.farm_interv: How long the farmer waits after finishing one plot before starting the next. 20 ticks = 1 second.
config.villager_workstations.rescan_plot: Takes the register of plots again from the farmland now inside the work area. Use this after building or extending a field, since the survey is otherwise only taken when the block is placed.
config.villager_workstations.seed_weight: This seed's weight, and the share of the field it works out to. Shares are worked out from the weights of the seeds actually in the container, so removing one re-divides the field between the rest. Set a weight to 0 to stop planting it.
How far the work area reaches in front of the station and behind it. Turning the block turns this axis with it.
config.villager_workstations.work_across: How far the work area reaches to either side of the station. Turning the block turns this axis with it.
How far the work area reaches above the station.
How far the work area reaches below the station. Raise this on a slope so the lower ground still counts.
message.villager_workstations.lumber_pla: Lumber station placed, %s trees in range
config.villager_workstations.enable_chop: Walk the work area and cut down every tree in it. The trunk comes down first, then the leaves that belonged to it — including nether fungus hats, which do not decay on their own. Planks, fences and anything else not in the log or leaves tags are left alone.
config.villager_workstations.enable_repl: Plant a sapling again after a tree comes down. Which sapling comes from the station's stock and the Saplings tab. Whether planting spends the item follows the global consume-seeds rule.
config.villager_workstations.auto_planti:
On: also plant saplings on any spot in the area that has the right soil, enough light and room for a tree to grow, spaced so they are not carpeted together.
Off: only replant the exact stumps the lumberjack left.
config.villager_workstations.force_growi: Spend bone meal from the station on crops or saplings already in the ground. Vanilla's own chance applies, so one tap does not finish the job. Does nothing when the station has no bone meal.
config.villager_workstations.lumber_inte: How long the lumberjack waits after finishing one swing before starting the next. 20 ticks = 1 second.
config.villager_workstations.sapling_wei: This sapling's weight, and the share of the plantings it works out to. Shares are worked out from the weights of the saplings actually in the station, so removing one re-divides the wood between the rest. Set a weight to 0 to stop planting it.
